item.title: 🇺🇸 Today, we honor the courage, commitment, and sacrifice of our nation's veterans.
item.description:
🇺🇸 Today, we honor the courage, commitment, and sacrifice of our nation's veterans.
On Veterans Day, Arlington ISD extends our heartfelt gratitude to the men and women who have served in the United States Armed Forces. We are especially grateful for the veterans who continue to make a difference in our schools and community as educators, staff members, parents, grandparents, and community leaders.
Your dedication to service is an example for our students and a reminder of the importance of honoring those who have served our country.
❤️ To all veterans, thank you for your service. Happy Veterans Day!
